WD My Passport 5TB Portable External Hard Drive USB 3.0 - Black

Securely carry your massive data, high-resolution media, and critical backups anywhere with the WD My Passport 5TB Portable External Hard Drive, distributed via Turbo Computer Egypt. Designed with a sleek, compact black chassis, this slim portable storage unit offers an expansive 5TB capacity that fits right in the palm of your hand. It features ultra-fast plug-and-play connectivity via standard USB 3.0 interfaces, while remaining fully backward compatible with USB 2.0 systems. Equipped with advanced 256-bit AES hardware encryption and built-in password protection software, your confidential files stay completely safe from unauthorized access. This highly reliable portable HDD operates seamlessly out of the box and is backed by a 1-year store warranty.
